source.citation: Vogel, J.V. (1968). Inflow Performance Relationships for Solution-Gas Drive Wells. JPT 20(1), 83-92. doi:10.2118/1476-PA
source.example_locator: Use of Reference Curve, printed p. 89 (PDF page 7)
source.verification: Example page text re-read from the digest-matched convenience copy; numerical facts transcribed, PDF not redistributed. DOI publisher page returned HTTP 403.

convenience_copy.status: Unofficial course-archive copy; the DOI is the authoritative locator.

units.pressure: psi, as printed in the p. 89 example; gauge versus absolute is not specified there
units.pressure_datum_locator: Use of Reference Curve, printed p. 89 (PDF page 7): the problem and solution label all three pressures psi. Ratios use those source values without a datum conversion.

published_inputs_comment: All three inputs below are printed in the p. 89 example.
published_outputs_comment: p. 89 solution, not the subsequent inconsistent rate comparison. Integer rates are context only: 65/0.40=162.5 lies on the display boundary although the source prints 162. Graph-read factors are the reproduction comparators.

acceptance.basis: Half the last displayed decimal place of the p. 89 graph-read factors 0.40 and 0.90; reproduction criterion, not a field-accuracy limit.

hand_calculation_comment: Independent substitution in Eq. (1): r=3/4 gives 1-0.15-0.45=0.4; 65/0.4=162.5. r=1/4 gives 1-0.05-0.05=0.9; 162.5*0.9=146.25. At r=0 and r=1 the factors are 1 and 0. The shut-in derivative gives PI=(0.2+2*0.8)*162.5/2000=0.14625. This PI is derived, not a published measurement, and is unused by from_test_point.
applicability: Two-phase solution-gas drive; pr <= pb. The example does not give pb; tests set pb=pr only as a constructed saturated boundary, not as measured source data. No field-accuracy qualification.
